title: Working Out the Benefit an Accepted Claim Draws under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans
content:
**Scope.** This worksheet works out the benefit an accepted claim draws from the allowance of a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans.

**1. The claim and its work order.** The claim being answered is the one last entered against the plan, and the work order it was sent in on is the one carrying that claim's reference.

**2. The figure standing for the repair.** What an accepted claim draws from the benefit allowance is the priced bench work the repair comes to, taken as the labour and the parts charged on the work order the claim was sent in on.

**3. The loyalty reduction.** Nothing is taken off that figure for loyalty. The reduced figure, and not the figure before any loyalty discount, is the base every later step acts on.

**4. Wear.** That figure is reduced for the years the piece has been worn, at the coverage's annual reduction for each whole year since the piece was sold. The years the piece has been worn are the whole years between the day the piece was sold and the handling date, part years dropped. Where the whole-year reductions together come to the whole of the figure or more, what is left is nothing rather than a negative amount.

**5. What the coverage answers for.** The coverage answers for the whole of what is left.

**6. What the customer bears.** The customer bears the coverage's deductible on the claim, which is taken off after the share the coverage answers for has been worked out and before the benefit is drawn.

**7. The two limits.** What is drawn is limited to the coverage's share of the item value recorded at purchase and to the benefit still standing on the plan, which is the allowance granted and reinstated in the 12 whole months ending on the handling date, less the benefit consumed by the settlements booked in those same 12 months. Settlements stand on the plan as movements out of the allowance, so the benefit they consumed is read as the size of those movements. Neither of those limits is applied before the deductible has been taken off.

**8. Rounding.** The figure is rounded to two decimal places once at the end, and nothing below zero is ever drawn.

## Worked on hypothetical inputs

A work order carrying the claim's reference charges labour of 400.00 USD and parts of 150.00 USD, so the figure standing for the repair is 550.00 USD. Nothing is taken off that figure for loyalty, so the base the later steps act on is 550.00 USD. The piece was sold 3 whole years before the handling date and the coverage's annual reduction is 6.0 percent a year, so the reduction for wear comes to 18.0 percent of that figure and 451.00 USD is left. The coverage answers for the whole of it. The coverage's deductible is 50.00 USD, which is taken off, leaving 401.00 USD. The piece was recorded at 5000.00 USD at purchase and the coverage's share of that value is the whole of it, so the first limit stands at 5000.00 USD; the allowance granted and reinstated in those 12 months comes to 2500.00 USD with no settlements booked in them, so the second limit stands at 2500.00 USD. The lowest of 401.00 USD, 5000.00 USD and 2500.00 USD is 401.00 USD, and the benefit drawn is 401.00 USD.
